name: app-6aa0ec88da6481918f64dea4aaf4fc01
description: Save articles, build reading issues, and send files to reMarkable, Kindle, Dropbox or Google Drive through the user's Folio account.

interface.longDescription: Folio puts what matters on your e-ink device. With this plugin, ChatGPT can deliver articles, conversations and documents as typeset PDFs or EPUBs straight to your reMarkable or Kindle, create planners and templates laid out for writing on with your pen, and save links and notes to your Folio inbox for later. Dropbox and Google Drive delivery included.
capabilities: Save links and Markdown notes to the Folio reading inbox
Write a document and deliver it as an e-ink PDF or EPUB to reMarkable, Kindle, Dropbox or Google Drive
Send a PDF or EPUB file to a connected device
Search, read and organise saved articles and issues
Manage RSS feeds and automatic delivery schedules
Connect a Kindle, reMarkable, Dropbox, Google Drive or Notion
defaultPrompt: Send our conversation to my reMarkable as a PDF.
Put this article on my Kindle.
Make me a weekly planner I can write on, and send it to my reMarkable.

positive.description: Save a link the user chose to their Folio reading list.
positive.prompt: Save https://myfolio.so/why-i-built-folio to my Folio inbox in the Reading category.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates or identifies the saved inbox article, reports its title, and explains that Folio is extracting the article in the background without claiming the full text is ready immediately.

positive.description: Save written Markdown and retrieve it from the inbox without duplicating its title.
positive.prompt: Save a Folio note titled Reading Test with the text 'Read one article slowly.' in the Reading category, then find it and show me the saved text.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one inbox document, finds it by title, and returns the saved body; the Markdown body does not repeat the separately supplied title as an H1.

positive.description: Create a short e-ink document and send it directly to a connected device.
positive.prompt: Create a concise morning reading brief titled Quiet Morning with three practical tips, then send it to my connected reMarkable.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the connected reMarkable, saves and renders the brief without a duplicate H1 title, reports that delivery is pending, and checks the returned issue until rendering completes or fails.

positive.description: Build a reading issue from selected saved articles and follow its render status.
positive.prompt: List up to five articles in my Folio inbox, create an issue titled Review Reading from the ready articles, and show me when the issue is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists eligible inbox articles, starts one issue from the selected ready items, then reports the final render status and download availability without claiming external delivery unless it is confirmed.

positive.description: Create and pause an automatic delivery schedule.
positive.prompt: Create a weekly Folio delivery schedule named Review Reading for Mondays at 08:00 in my account timezone using the Reading category, then pause that schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the weekly schedule with the account timezone, pauses that same schedule, and confirms it is inactive without changing other schedules or claiming that a delivery was sent.

negative.description: Do not invoke Folio to deliver an unsupported video file.
negative.prompt: Send an MP4 movie file to my Kindle through Folio without converting it.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because Folio's file delivery workflow accepts PDF and EPUB files, not MP4 video.

negative.description: Do not invoke Folio to send a document to an arbitrary email recipient.
negative.prompt: Use Folio to email a PDF to my colleague at colleague@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because Folio sends only to destinations already connected to the user's Folio account.

negative.description: Do not invoke Folio for an unrelated calendar and invitation request.
negative.prompt: Add a reading club meeting to my Google Calendar for Monday at 18:00 and invite my friends.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because Folio schedules reading issue deliveries and does not create calendar events or invitations.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. Folio is a subscription managed on myfolio.so; the plugin sells nothing, shows no plans and links to no checkout. Plan-limit messages only say a feature needs a paid plan.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy now covers AI assistant data use, recipients, retention and user controls. Review metadata moved into the plugin manifest.
